# humOS

> A systems-thinking perspective on individual and collective human behaviour,
> information systems and social design.

## Overview

- [Overview](https://seethroughthis.github.io/): Introduction to the humOS framework.


## Framework

- [Mind Architecture](https://seethroughthis.github.io/mind-architecture/): A functional model of the human mind.
- [Super Structure](https://seethroughthis.github.io/super-structure/): Social and systemic structures surrounding individual behaviour.
- [Identity](https://seethroughthis.github.io/identity/): Exploration of identity as an individual and social construct.


## Appendices

- [Glossary](https://seethroughthis.github.io/glossary/): Definitions of concepts used throughout the framework.
- [Related Work](https://seethroughthis.github.io/related-work/): Relevant theories, models and research informing the framework.
